title: AI by Hand
summary: AI by Hand is a website focused on teaching and demystifying artificial intelligence concepts through hands-on, manual approaches. It appears to help users understand AI by walking through algorithms and concepts step-by-step rather than treating them as black boxes.
problem_solved: Makes complex AI/ML concepts accessible and understandable through visual, hands-on learning instead of overwhelming users with abstract theory.
why_valuable: Bridges the gap between theoretical AI knowledge and practical understanding by allowing users to see and interact with AI concepts step-by-step.
